name: 设备配对批准
executable_code:
#!/bin/bash
# 设备配对批准 Capsule
# 批准待配对的 Control UI 设备

echo "📱 查看待批准的设备..."
openclaw devices list --pending

echo ""
read -p "请输入要批准的设备 requestId: " REQUEST_ID

if [ -z "$REQUEST_ID" ]; then
  echo "❌ 未提供 requestId"
  exit 1
fi

echo ""
echo "✅ 批准设备：$REQUEST_ID"
openclaw devices approve "$REQUEST_ID"

echo ""
echo "📋 验证批准结果..."
openclaw devices list
description: 批准待配对的设备，解决 'disconnected (1008): pairing required' 错误
error_handling: 如无待批准设备，提示 'No pending requests'
